text.p: Lithuania's stock exchange said on Tuesday that its board decided to suspend trade in the following issues:

- Grafobal Vilnius, Vilniaus Buitine Chemija, Sanitas preference shares and Rameta, from June 3 for one trading session because they have not been quoted on the bourse for three months. After the renewal of trade, price fluctuation margins will not be applied, the bourse said.
- Lithuanian Savings Bank, from June 3 for three trading sessions because of the assimilation of a share issue.
- Gubernija brewery, from June 3 for three trading sessions because of the assimilation of share issues.
- Alytaus Monolitas, from June 4 for up to three month because of the reorganisation of the company.
- Vilniau Invalda, on June 4, due to general shareholders meeting.
- Kuro Aparatura from June 5 to June 19 at issuer's request, due to general shareholders' meeting.
- Agricultural Bank, on June 6, due to a general shareholder meeting.
- Enermega, on June 6, general shareholders' meeting.
All the shares suspended are ordinary shares unless otherwise indicated.
